lines: [sleepy, wide-eyed] Two thirteen a.m. [excited whisper] The best idea I've ever had.
[yawning, content] I'll remember it in the morning.
[flat, deadpan] I did not remember it in the morning.
[whispering] Rooftop café, for book lovers... swap a book, get a chai. [whispering] Call Priya about her terrace... Saturday.
[softly, sleepy] Tap. Say it. Back to sleep.
[delighted] And in the morning, it's all there. The idea, the next step... even a reminder.
[warm, confident] Shrutam. Catch it before it's gone.
